description: GECAD researchers publish network data supporting a thirteen-bus smart-city study of electric-vehicle charging prices. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook labelled as fifteen-minute data and a PDF network description, freely accessible under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The describing article explicitly links this deposit and uses a BISITE laboratory mock-up with distributed energy resources to compare dynamic and fixed charging prices. These inputs can benchmark distribution-operation and charging-behaviour simulations. Related catalogue data-ieee-pes-distribution-test-feeders covers standard feeder cases, not this documented pricing-study package. Coverage is a local experimental representation, not a city-wide measured grid. The study excludes vehicle-to-grid and uses simplified user and storage behaviour. Workbook field completeness and parameter uncertainty remain unverified, and the licence restricts derivatives and commercial reuse. No files were downloaded or optimisation rerun.
